_doc: Every evaluation dataset, its version, split and content hash. Changing a file without giving it a new version and hash here fails tests/test_eval_harness.py, so results from different content are never compared as if they were the same. dev sets may be used to improve the coach; holdout sets are only measured (see docs/AI_EVALUATION.md, 'Held-out sets').

datasets.provenance: Hand-written Java solutions to this repository's seeded problems, written for this project (no learner submissions). Each verdict label is verified by submitting the sample to the real judge (tests/test_judge_sandbox.py::test_eval_set_verdict_labels_match_the_real_judge, in CI).
datasets.labels: Issue categories and Big-O labels were assigned by hand from what a good interviewer would say about the code; they are not produced by the reviewer under test.
